column1: # English meanings for common Ukrainian words that Wiktionary has no page for, written for Nebokrai.
# This is Nebokrai's own writing, under CC BY-SA 4.0 with the rest of nebokrai.db.
# Nothing of VESUM's (its forms, tags or word lists) is copied into it: VESUM is CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 and stays in
# vesum.db. It only helped choose which words to write up, by how often they are met in film subtitles.
# import_wiktionary.py --own-meanings reads this file; a row whose spelling already has an entry is skipped.
#   headword  the same with the stress mark (U+0301) after the stressed vowel: обли́шити
#   pos       part of speech, named as in nebokrai.db: noun, verb, adj, adv, ...
#   glosses   the English meanings, "; " between two meanings: to leave (alone), to stop; to give up

#             written here becomes the entry's tags, and nothing else of it is stored
